'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Bill Kafer DS Drop! (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Drop! (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-32-Drop-remaster.webp|label=Drop! (V)}}
* '''Username:''' tacobill
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
